precondition: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200). An Administrator account holding AdminUsers, a Secretary account without it, and target accounts in the needed state (active, deactivated, Google-only) supplied by QA lead. A controlled inbox for password-reset emails.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/users lists every account, sorted by name, without secrets.
procedure: Sign in as the Administrator (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send GET /api/users with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
expected: HTTP 200 OK.
Body: an array; each item has { "id", "fullName", "email", "roleId", "roleName", "isActive", "hasPassword", "hasGoogleLink", "createdAt" }.
Deactivated accounts are listed too, with "isActive": false.
No item carries a password hash or a Google subject; the order is the Vietnamese name order ("Đ" sorts after "D", not after "Z").
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Administrator account holding AdminUsers, supplied by QA lead.
At least one deactivated account and one Google-only account exist.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/users answers 403 for a signed-in caller without AdminUsers.

preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Two administrator accounts; the access token of the first is still unexpired.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/users creates an active account and returns its location.

Body: { "code": "MSG07", "message": "Tạo tài khoản thành công.", "user": { "id", "fullName": "Trần Chủ Toạ", "email", "roleId", "roleName", "isActive": true, ... } }.

cases.description: Verify PUT /api/users/{id}/status deactivates an account and ends its sessions.

As the target, call POST /api/auth/refresh with the old cookie, then POST /api/auth/login with the correct password.
expected: Step 2: HTTP 200, body { "code": "MSG11", "message": "Đổi trạng thái tài khoản thành công.", "user": { "isActive": false, ... } }.
Step 3: both calls answer HTTP 401 with code "MSG02" ("Tài khoản không khả dụng. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên.").
The row is kept, and one audit entry "user.deactivated" is written.

Administrator account holding AdminUsers, supplied by QA lead.
An active target account that has signed in.

cases.description: Verify two administrators cannot deactivate each other into a system nobody can administer.
procedure: Sign in as Administrator A and as Administrator B (POST /api/auth/login) and keep both tokens.

expected: Step 2: HTTP 200, code "MSG11" (A still remains active).
Step 3: HTTP 403 (B was deactivated and is re-read from the database); A stays active.
At least one active account keeps AdminUsers; the refused request writes no audit entry.
